case.question: How many ER visits were there for children under 5 in 2025?
case.expected: 1,469,070 estimated visits (57,638 sample cases); Age < 5 gives 856,149

response: In 2025, there were an estimated 1,469,070 emergency room visits (based on 57,638 sample cases) for children under 5 across all products in the NEISS data.

args.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n_cases, ROUND(SUM(weight)) AS est_visits FROM neiss_cases WHERE year = 2025 AND age_years < 5

table.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n_cases, ROUND(SUM(weight)) AS est_visits FROM neiss_cases WHERE year = 2025 AND age_years < 5
